integrity: All numerical counts come from two independently constructed exact finite enumeration programs; published Klein-graph adjacency and the 24 perfect matchings are explicitly credited. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only simple six-cycle, seven-face orientable cellular embeddings of the Heawood graph. Numerical classifications are reproducible exact exhaustive results, not an infinite-family theorem; historical priority remains subject to independent literature audit.
title: Seven-face flips of the Heawood graph: eight toroidal face systems and frozen matchings
